study_summary.endpoint: Atypical cartilaginous tumour versus high-grade chondrosarcoma of long bones

rationale: Zenodo exposes a small spreadsheet, not the radiograph images needed to evaluate BoneScope's image classifier.
The narrow ACT-versus-high-grade-chondrosarcoma task does not match the BoneScope taxonomy.
The dataset record does not show an explicit license; the article's CC BY-NC-ND license does not confer image rights.
No stable patient/image manifest or checkpoint/pretraining overlap audit is available in the reviewed records.
